scripts.build: npm run build:chat && npm run build -w @sarchauhan/adapter-ai-sdk && npm run build -w @sarchauhan/chat-tui
scripts.build:ai-sdk-example: npm run build:ai-sdk && npm run build:chat && npm run build -w @sarchauhan/example-next-ai-sdk
scripts.build:adapter: npm run build -w @sarchauhan/protocol && npm run build -w @sarchauhan/adapter
scripts.build:ai-sdk: npm run build -w @sarchauhan/protocol && npm run build -w @sarchauhan/adapter && npm run build -w @sarchauhan/adapter-ai-sdk
scripts.build:chat: npm run build -w @sarchauhan/protocol && npm run build -w @sarchauhan/adapter && npm run build -w @sarchauhan/chat
scripts.build:chat-tui: npm run build -w @sarchauhan/protocol && npm run build -w @sarchauhan/adapter && npm run build -w @sarchauhan/chat-tui
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/protocol --noEmit && tsc -p packages/adapter --noEmit && tsc -p packages/adapter/ai-sdk --noEmit && tsc -p packages/chat --noEmit && tsc -p packages/chat-tui --noEmit
scripts.build:symphony-example: npm run build:chat && npm run build -w @sarchauhan/example-next-symphony
